submissionBlockers.detail: An accepted, versioned spatial guide that integrates all 18 sites, 17 empty plots, river-right approach, and full vertical envelope without clipping or shrinking is not yet available on disk. The owner explicitly instructed: "Never modify a submitted batch or start an additional batch14 under this instruction." Previous authorization covered batches 09-13 (150 requests) only.
